title: Tintiro2
description: Chinchiro dice gambling game - Requires EmeraldBank [ALPHA]
body:
# Tintiro2 - Chinchiro Dice Game

> ⚠️ **ALPHA VERSION** - This plugin is in development. Bugs may exist.

## ⚠️ Required: EmeraldBank

**[EmeraldBank](https://modrinth.com/plugin/emeraldbank2) is REQUIRED!**

This plugin uses EmeraldBank for the emerald economy system.

### Installation

1. Download [EmeraldBank](https://modrinth.com/plugin/emeraldbank2)
2. Download Tintiro2
3. Put both in your plugins folder
4. Restart server

## Overview

Chinchiro (チンチロ) is a traditional Japanese dice gambling game! Roll 3 dice and compete against the dealer using emeralds from your EmeraldBank balance.

## How It Works

1. Deposit emeralds to EmeraldBank (`/emerald deposit`)
2. Join Tintiro lobby (`/tintiro join`)
3. Set your bet (`/tintiro bet <amount>`)
4. Start game and roll dice!
5. Winnings/losses automatically update your balance

## Dice Hands

| Hand | Description | Payout |
|------|-------------|--------|
| Pinzoro (111) | Triple 1s | 5x |
| Zorome (222-666) | Other triples | 3x |
| Shigoro (456) | Sequence | 2x |
| Pair + Number | Score = number | 1x |
| Hifumi (123) | Bad sequence | -2x |
| Shonben | No hand | Auto lose |

## Commands

- `/tintiro join` - Join lobby
- `/tintiro leave` - Leave lobby
- `/tintiro bet <amount>` - Set bet
- `/tintiro start` - Start game
- `/tintiro open` - Roll dice

Alias: `/ti`

## Requirements

- **[EmeraldBank](https://modrinth.com/plugin/emeraldbank2) (REQUIRED)**
- Spigot/Paper 1.21.x
- Java 17+
